svg.title: WSO2 Open Healthcare accelerators and architecture
svg.desc: Consumer apps used by patients, practitioners and management connect to the WSO2 healthcare platform. The platform provides AI agents, MCPs, APIs, integrations and healthcare accelerators, on top of identity and access management, integration and API management, with a FHIR repository on PostgreSQL. It connects to systems of record such as EMR/EHR, laboratory, radiology, pharmacy and billing systems. Development tools include the FHIR package generator, FHIR API template generator, CDS template generator and Healthcare Copilot.
